description: Test whether the PC-like GH116 architecture is enriched for the lowest UniProt evidence class, and plot the family survey with evidence-class breakdown; save the family table as provenance
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, os
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

u1=pd.read_csv("out/pc_like_quality.csv"); u2=pd.read_csv("out/core_quality.csv")
a=(u1.pe=="4: Predicted").sum(); b=len(u1)-a
c=(u2.pe=="4: Predicted").sum(); d=len(u2)-c
orr,p=fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
print(f"'4: Predicted' PC-like {a}/{len(u1)} ({100*a/len(u1):.0f}%) vs core {c}/{len(u2)} ({100*c/len(u2):.0f}%)")
print(f"Fisher exact OR={orr:.2f}, p={p:.3g}")
# 95% CI on log odds (Woolf)
se=np.sqrt(1/a+1/b+1/c+1/d); lo,hi=np.exp(np.log(orr)-1.96*se),np.exp(np.log(orr)+1.96*se)
print(f"95% CI {lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f}")

df=pd.read_csv("out/gh116_family.csv")
both=df[(df.cat_start.notna())&(df.nt_len>0)]
pc_like=both[(both.nt_start<=60)&(both.nt_len<280)&(both.nt_len>150)]
print("\nfamily n=%d, both domains=%d, PC-like=%d (%.2f%%)"%(len(df),len(both),len(pc_like),100*len(pc_like)/len(both)))
print("PF12215 length: median %.0f IQR %.0f-%.0f; PC=247 (%.1f pct), PB=329, human=305"
      %(both.nt_len.median(),both.nt_len.quantile(.25),both.nt_len.quantile(.75),
        100*(both.nt_len<247).mean()))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.hist(both.nt_len,bins=np.arange(0,420,8),color="#7f9fc4",edgecolor="none")
for nm,v,c_ in [("PC 247","247","#c0392b"),("human GBA2 305","305","#7d3c98"),("PB 329","329","#2a7a2a")]:
    ax.axvline(int(v),color=c_,lw=2)
    ax.text(int(v)+3,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.92,nm,rotation=90,va="top",fontsize=8,color=c_)
ax.set_xlabel("PF12215 match length, residues"); ax.set_ylabel("proteins")
ax.set_title("A  GH116 N-terminal domain match length, 4991 proteins")

ax=axes[1]
lab=["PC-like\n(n=%d)"%len(u1),"core architecture\n(n=%d)"%len(u2)]
pred=[100*a/len(u1),100*c/len(u2)]; other=[100-pred[0],100-pred[1]]
ax.bar(lab,pred,color="#c0392b",label="4: Predicted")
ax.bar(lab,other,bottom=pred,color="#9fb8d4",label="1-3: protein, transcript or homology")
ax.set_ylabel("percent of sampled entries")
ax.set_title("B  UniProt evidence class\nOR %.1f (95%% CI %.1f-%.1f), Fisher p = %.1g"%(orr,lo,hi,p))
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# provenance tables
for target in ["provenance","/agent/jobs/36b221e0-0ead-4281-92b7-12090a5046a4/provenance"]:
    try:
        os.makedirs(target,exist_ok=True)
        both.assign(pc_like=both.index.isin(pc_like.index)).to_csv(target+"/gh116_family_survey.csv",index=False)
        print("wrote",target+"/gh116_family_survey.csv")
        break
    except Exception as ex:
        print("could not write",target,ex)
